findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 2, Harm 2
Raise: Not done. New evidence beyond the earlier adjacency and redismissal findings: line 661 treats the cited line as unchanged if identical text appears anywhere else in the file. In a normal file with two `return None` lines, changing the cited one while leaving the other causes `_cited_changed` to return false, so the repeated finding remains dismissed even though the code its reason cited changed. The new test uses unique line text and cannot catch this case.
